motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press scale to 0.98; removed for reduced motion and keyboard focus.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main action for the current task, with a visible pending or disabled state.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--primary, #a40000); color: #fff; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px/1.5 system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a40000; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #6a1314; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference) { .ds-primary { transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { transform:none; transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: transparent; color: #6a1314; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid #887a6b; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px/1.5 system-ui; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a40000; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#faf6ef; } }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Permanent labels with associated help and errors.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#30231d; font:600 14px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #887a6b; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#30231d; font:16px/1.5 system-ui; caret-color:#a40000; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a40000; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:#a40000; } .ds-input:disabled { background:#faf6ef; }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: Compact dark red navigation with an explicit current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:8px; background:#6a1314; color:#fff; padding:0 16px; font:15px/1.5 system-ui; } .ds-nav a { padding:20px 12px; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; text-decoration:none; color:#f3ebdf; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { border-color:#f3ebdf; font-weight:650; color:#fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3ebdf; outline-offset:-4px; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-nav a:hover { background:#7b2021; } }

components.name: Photo work area
components.description: A view label, whole-photo review frame and native file selection form a single work area.

narrative.overview: The interface puts the photo pair and price publication tasks first. A cream canvas, dark red navigation and red primary actions preserve the incumbent identity. System typography and native controls keep repeated actions familiar.
dos: Do preserve the cream/red identity and familiar native form behavior.
Do show server-derived prices, provenance and status truthfully.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, structural mobile stacking and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't add model overlays, invented weights, confidence, valuations or institutional affiliation.
Don't animate numbers or move readable data for decoration.
Don't hide errors in temporary notifications or replace labels with placeholders.
